brief.aim: The table holds only seven homogeneous kernel-geometry measurements (area, perimeter, compactness, kernel length/width, asymmetry coefficient, groove length) with no plausible outcome column, so the evident aim is to segment kernel samples into natural geometric groups via clustering on the standardized features.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated-subject structure; each row is a distinct kernel sample.
brief.unit: One wheat kernel sample described by its geometric measurements (one row).
